sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 27
34 Stat. 3058 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Proclamation of May 29, 1905, Theodore Roosevelt: "shall be known as The Sawtooth Forest Reserve"

Presidential Executive Orders, Numbered 1-8030, 1862-1938 (WPA Historical Records Survey, 1944), vol. 1, list entry 858: June 26, 1908, Sawtooth National Forest, Idaho, diminished and the excluded lands constituted portions of the Boise, Challis, Lemhi, and Payette

review.note: Wrong event. EO 858 (June 26, 1908) cut land from the Sawtooth to form other forests; it did not establish the Sawtooth. The Sawtooth Forest Reserve was established by Theodore Roosevelt, Proclamation 562, May 29, 1905, 34 Stat. 3058.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Sawtooth: Part deleted to establish Boise. Land transferred to Challis, Lemhi and Payette.
